name: HeyMilo
tagline: AI interviewer agents that screen candidates across voice, video, and SMS.
description: HeyMilo builds AI interviewer agents that automate first-round candidate screening. Its AI reads a job description from the ATS, generates an adaptive interview, and conducts it across voice, video, phone, or SMS, asking follow-up questions, then transcribes and scores responses for hiring managers.
insight: Raised a $2.2M seed led by Canaan Partners (Mar 2025); founders are ex-Instagram, Microsoft, and Salesforce.
edge: Conducts adaptive interviews across voice, video, phone, and SMS — broader channel coverage than video-only AI screeners.

references.title: HeyMilo Secures $2.2M to Interview Candidates at Scale with AI Agents
